{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p5","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Go early, before the selfie sticks wake up. The grove hums if you let it."},{"poi_id":"p6","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m3","note":"Shoes off, phone down, eyes up. The garden does the talking."},{"poi_id":"p2","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m4","note":"Gold leaf that doesn't care about your camera. Worth the bus back into town."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p9","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Silver pavilion, moss garden, and a view that rewards the climb."},{"poi_id":"p8","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Canal-side stroll under maples, with the occasional heron judging your pace."},{"poi_id":"p12","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A thousand wooden kannon, each one watching you more politely than the last."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p1","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m1","note":"Foxes and vermilion gates all the way up; go early before the path becomes a queue."},{"poi_id":"p14","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m2","note":"Steam, shinkansen and a roundhouse full of giants; even the non-train people slow down here."},{"poi_id":"p3","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The wooden stage hangs over the maples like a dare; the view does the rest."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p4","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m5","note":"Graze the stalls like a tanuki with a very small basket and a very large plan."},{"poi_id":"p19","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"A gentle, plant-based pause that still feels like a proper Kyoto sit-down."},{"poi_id":"p7","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Walk slowly here; the old wooden facades reward anyone who bothers to look up."},{"poi_id":"p13","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Lantern light, narrow lanes, and the sound of your own excellent decisions."},{"poi_id":"p19","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Back for a quiet dinner before the evening gets too clever for its own good."}]}
Lanterns, shrines, bamboo, temples, castle — all in, shoes off, phone down, eyes up.
